allies.rationale_text: Risk-vs-uncertainty helps true-uncertainty-navigation keep robust action tied to how much of the uncertainty is actually reducible.
allies.source_quote: uncertainty is materially affecting capital allocation, sequencing, or commitment decisions
allies.affinity_rationale: Risk-vs-uncertainty distinction is foundational; canonical describes five-level uncertainty schema for navigating ambiguity
allies.activation_condition: When distinguishing between quantifiable risk and true uncertainty determines which analytical tools apply

allies.rationale_text: Step-back helps true-uncertainty-navigation avoid panic or premature commitment by forcing a wider look before choosing the next action.
allies.source_quote: put your plan aside and focus elsewhere for a while
allies.affinity_rationale: Canonical emphasizes metacognitive monitoring and problem reframing, which stepping back enables
allies.activation_condition: When reflective pause enables metacognitive assessment of the problem framing under uncertain conditions

antagonists.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias makes true-uncertainty-navigation dishonest by adjusting uncertainty estimates to protect the expected answer.
antagonists.source_quote: the mind is biased to just accept and applaud confirming evidence
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Canonical structured tension identifies confirmation bias as adjusting uncertainty estimates to confirm expected outcomes
antagonists.activation_condition: When uncertainty estimates are adjusted to confirm expected outcomes rather than honestly reflecting information limits
